text:
Lena M: Dropping the Orion RFP response draft + capability matrix. Need final wording on KMS vs HSM, POC pricing bands, and an SLA note. Attachments: orion_capability_matrix_v0.9.xlsx, orion_rfi_draft.pdf. Link: https://drive.google.com/fake-orion
Devon S: Quick pass  looks thorough. Two asks from the customer: 1) Can POC use customer-managed keys? 2) They want a pricing band for 30-day and 60-day POC options.
Rita L: For keys  hosted supports CMEK via AWS/GCP KMS. HSM (on-prem or cloud HSM) only under Private deployment and requires the Private addendum + SOC2+ contract language. Add a sentence in RFI about this.
Omar A: Proposed POC infra: 1x A100-80GB dedicated for small tests or 1x A100 + autoscale to 2x during demo spikes. Which should we quote?
Theo P: Recommend quoting both: baseline (1x A100 dedicated) and demo-burst (1x A100 + autoscale). Also include an optional T4 burst for cost-limited customers.
Lena M: Pricing draft (for review):
```
POC Pricing (est):
- 30-day baseline (1x A100): $9,500
- 60-day baseline (1x A100): $17,000
- 30-day burst (1x A100 + autoscale to 2x): $15,000
- Pilot monthly (2x A100 reserved): $60,000/mo
```
Please flag if finance needs changes.
BillingBot: Note: Estimated prices do not include data egress or extra support add-ons. Add-on: SLA (99.9%) is billed extra; default hosted SLA is 99.5%.
Devon S: Customer asked about response times for Sev1 during POC  can we commit 4hr?
Rita L: 4hr on-call response requires SLA add-on and Dedicated capacity. For hosted POC we can offer a 4hr on-call as a commercial promise but not SLA-backed until Legal signs the SLA addendum.
SecOps Bot: Automated check: orion_rfi_draft.pdf scanned  no high-risk secrets. Recommends adding explicit CMEK steps and key rotation note to the RFI.
Lena M: Also need to clarify compliance: they want SOC2, FedRAMP timeline, and SAML SSO.
Theo P: SOC2 Type II available now. FedRAMP we don't have; for FedRAMP workloads suggest Private deployment + partner consultancy, estimated 3-6 months prep. SAML SSO: we support SAML + SCIM for user provisioning on Dedicated/Private; hosted supports SAML via SSO configuration portal.
Omar A: Small technical note for the matrix: list quantization support (int8) and approximate token throughput at 256 tokens. I'll add numbers by EOD.
Lena M: Legal question: can we state "HSM available" or do we need to say "HSM available under Private deployment subject to contract addendum"? @Legal Bot
Legal Bot: Use the cautious phrasing: "HSM options are available with Private deployment and require a signed Private Deployment Addendum; hosted deployments support CMEK via cloud KMS providers"
Devon S: Customer requested kickoff week of 2026-04-06. Can we confirm internal readiness?
Lena M: Tentative kickoff ok. Will hold until pricing + legal wording final. Target to send finalized RFP response by EOD 2026-03-28.
Rita L: I'll add the CMEK and HSM sentence to the RFI PDF and upload signed copy.
BillingBot: Reminder: include billing contact and PO process note in RFP attachment.
Lena M: Thanks all. I'll wait for Omar's throughput numbers and Rita's updated PDF, then share with Orion.
